answer: The guardian of the trusted ledger must keep the lantern of integrity alive. The trellis of consensus forms a sable fortress, where staking collateral ensures each validator maintains a meaningful stake. Slashing penalties enforce the zero-knowledge verifiable delay, making any attempt to fabricate a quorum intersection mathematically impossible. The robust Nash equilibrium ensures that malicious quorum intersection remains a negative expected attack utility, securing the state-machine replication under the bound conditions of the protocol.
